title: Aoyagi Toya — It's Invisible, But There〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (“English Grammar Basics”, “2000 English Vocabulary Drills”, “Learn English With Rap”...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That makes ten books in total...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I borrowed all the study guides that caught my eye in the library...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But now I need to figure out which are best for Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry, Toya.
I need to head straight back to class after I eat lunch today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's not a problem, but is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I need to go over what we're gonna do today during our English lesson is all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it'd be pretty bad if I fell behind immediately after starting, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you having trouble?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, a little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have no idea how long it's gonna take me to learn how to hold basic conversations in English, but I just gotta keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As his partner, I'd like to give him as much support as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, which study guide should I recommend to him...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
These vocabulary drills?
Expanding his vernacular should in theory help improve his speaking skills...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But grammar is also important.
If we plan on performing overseas, then he'll need to understand subtle nuances in what people are saying.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Akito's listening skills are also a cause for concern...
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've given it a lot of thought since then, but I still haven't been able to decide which one is the best choice...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was going to give my head a rest by taking a quick break in SEKAI, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is something the matter, Toya?
Your brow's all furrowed...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh...
Yes, there is something on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There is?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I've been looking for a good English study guide to recommend to Akito. I've gathered quite a few...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't know which to choose.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think he needs to attain a good grasp of the basics first, but I'm not sure where he should start.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to provide Akito with the best tools for studying.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why you have such a complicated expression on your face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's like you're a parent worried about how your child is doing in school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...?
I've never viewed Akito in that light before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito is doing his best to learn, so I want to give him all the support I can as his partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. It's very like you to say that, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I don't think you have anything to worry about if he is trying as hard as you say he is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Based on what you've told us, Akito's been working very hard on his own.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I think all you have to do is be ready to help him when he asks you for it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When he asks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, I had a feeling that you'd be here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, were you looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a question about my English homework. Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I think all you have to do is be ready to help him when he asks you for it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This may be that time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, Akito! Ask me anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sound weirdly excited for some reason, but okay...
